chapter.li: LEChapter5 Verse1 After king Benjamin had said all these things to his people, he sent out a message, asking his people if they believed what he taught them. VerseEnd Verse2 And they all cried out with one voice, saying: Yes, we believe everything 2PSI you’ve taught us. And we know these things are true because of the Spirit of the Lord Omnipotent, which has caused a big change in our hearts. We’re not inclined to do evil anymore, but rather want to continually do good. VerseEnd Verse3 We, through God’s infinite goodness and the manifestations of His Spirit, can clearly envision what’s to come. And if necessary, we could even prophesy about all of it. VerseEnd Verse4 And it’s our faith in the things our king has taught us that’s given us this valuable knowledge, which makes us rejoice! VerseEnd Verse5 We’re willing to enter into a covenant with God, promising to obey His commandments and do His will for the rest of our lives. We don’t want to cause ourselves the never-ending torment described by the angel, nor do we want to incur God’s anger. VerseEnd

Verse6 Now these are the words king Benjamin hoped to hear from them. Therefore he told them: 2PP You’ve said the words I wanted to hear, and the covenant 2PP you’ve made is a righteous covenant. VerseEnd Verse7 Now because of the covenant 2PP you’ve made, 2PP you’ll be called the sons and daughters of Jesus Christ. Today, He has spiritually begotten 2PP you. 2PP You’ve said 2PP your hearts have changed through faith in His name. As a result, 2PP you’re born of Him and have become His sons and daughters. VerseEnd Verse8 2PP You’re now free under His wings, and there’s no other Savior under whose wings 2PP you can be sheltered. There’s no other name given through which salvation comes. Therefore all of 2PP you who have made the covenant with God to be obedient for the remainder of 2PP your lives, take upon yourselves the name of Christ. VerseEnd Verse9 Those who do this will be found at the right hand of God and will answer to the name of Christ. VerseEnd

Verse10 However, anyone who doesn’t answer to the name of Christ will have to answer to some other name and will be found on God’s left hand. VerseEnd Verse11 I want to remind 2PP you that I provided 2PP you with a name that should never be erased except through transgression. Therefore please be careful not to transgress, so that the name remains in 2PP your hearts. VerseEnd Verse12 Remember to always keep the name of God in 2PP your hearts. This way, 2PP you won’t be found on His left hand, but rather 2PP you’ll hear and recognize the voice He uses to call 2PP you forth and the name He’ll use to call 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse13 Indeed, how can a person recognize a master they haven’t served, a stranger who’s far from the thoughts and intents of their heart? VerseEnd Verse14 Also, would someone take their neighbor’s donkey and keep it? No, they wouldn’t even let it feed among their flocks; they would drive it away and remove it. Therefore I tell 2PP you that it will be the same for 2PP you if 2PP you don’t know the name used to call 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse15 Thus, I want 2PP you to be firm and immovable, always filled with good works, so Christ, the Lord God Omnipotent, can seal 2PP you as His own. This way, 2PP you can be brought to heaven and have everlasting salvation and eternal life through the wisdom, power, justice, and mercy of Him who created all things in heaven and on earth, who’s God above all.
